title: Tianji Pavilion Emissary
next_chapter_hook: The seven-day countdown has already begun. In this time, can Chen Ji find a third path? Or will he only be able to survive in the narrow crevice between the Tianji Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Dao?

text.content: Before Chen Ji's words had even finished, the sky changed abruptly. The originally bright sky above the Tianqing Sect was suddenly gripped by an invisible giant hand—the light faded visibly before the naked eye, replaced by a suffocating, profound darkness. The distant mountain silhouettes remained, but seemed shrouded in a veil, blurred and unreal. The wind stopped; even the birdsong and insect chirps fell silent in this moment. As if heaven and earth itself were holding its breath, waiting for something. Chen Ji stood in place, squinting toward that ink-like void, his heartstring pulled to its absolute limit. He knew—what was coming had finally come.

Just then, a pair of eyes opened in the depths of the void. No eyelids, no face, only a pair of eyes so profound they seemed capable of devouring stars, suspended in the void directly above Chen Ji. The pupils were flowing gold, with countless points of light flickering within, as if containing some ancient law. Those eyes held no emotional fluctuations, yet Chen Ji felt a bone-deep chill—as if before those eyes, all his secrets were laid bare. The Tianji Pavilion Emissary's voice rang in Chen Ji's mind, not through his eardrums but directly shaking his soul: 'Variable... I have waited for you for a long time.'

dialogue.content: 'Between you and me, there was originally no fate. But the incomplete Tianji Record in your possession makes me unable to ignore you.' Those eyes narrowed slightly, as if examining an interesting toy. 'Do you know how many epochs the confrontation between the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the Tianji Pavilion has lasted? Thirty million years? Three hundred million years? Time, for us, has long lost its meaning. And you—you are one of the few variables across countless cycles.'

text.content: Chen Ji's expression remained unchanged, but his heart was already in turmoil. Thirty million years of confrontation? Such secrets, even Mo Xiansheng never mentioned. He took a deep breath, suppressing the turmoil in his heart, and when he spoke, his voice remained steady: 'What does the Emissary mean by variable? I am merely a废物, holding a fragmentary secret art, barely surviving in the crevices between three great sects. By what virtue could I be called a variable?' A hint of amusement flickered in those eyes, as if pleased by Chen Ji's composure.

dialogue.content: '废物?' The Emissary let out an ambiguous light laugh. 'No one chosen by the Tianji Record has ever been worthless. Do you know how many Tianji Record holders throughout history had peaceful ends? Among every ten, nine died from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's erasure, and the remaining one...' The Emissary paused, and a rare solemnity passed through those eyes. 'Chose to end themselves for解脱. And you—you are the only one to have survived to this day from a certain death situation.'

text.content: The air seemed to solidify for a moment. Beside Chen Ji, Ye Qing's face had already paled considerably. As a Holy Sect saint, she had of course heard the legends about Tianji Record holders—each one brilliant, each one meeting an untimely death. And now, witnessing this terrifying existence speak these words, she truly realized what kind of mountains of corpses and rivers of blood Chen Ji had climbed through to arrive here. Chen Ji noticed Ye Qing's change in expression, his heart sinking slightly, but his face remained impassive: 'The Emissary's visit surely isn't merely to tell me these old tales?'

dialogue.content: 'Of course not.' The amusement in those eyes deepened. 'I have come to make a deal with you. The Tianji Pavilion can help you break that deathly劫, so you need not die from the Eye of Heavenly Dao's erasure in Chapter 700. In exchange—' The Emissary's voice became solemn. 'You must become a Tianji Pavilion 'Observer.' Every time you use the Tianji Record to peer into the future, the Tianji Pavilion will see that river of fate together with you.'

choice.prompt: The Tianji Pavilion's deal lies before you—trading the right of foresight for the possibility of breaking the death trap. This is a major choice that could alter the course of destiny, and Chen Ji must make a decision.

choices.description: Trade foresight for survival. Though the Tianji Pavilion will see everything, at least you can live. Only by living can there be the possibility of a reversal.
choices.visible_cost: Lose exclusive foresight from the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Possibility to break the death trap
choices.risk_hint: Tianji Pavilion can see all your plans and secrets

text.content: Chen Ji did not answer immediately. His gaze lingered in those profound eyes for a moment, as if trying to see through something. After a moment, the corners of his mouth lifted slightly, revealing a meaningful smile: 'These words from the Emissary sound like delivering coal in the snow. But I am curious—what exactly is the Tianji Pavilion after?' His voice was soft, yet each word was clear. 'For the Tianji Pavilion to go to such great lengths to find me, there must be something worth betting on in me.'

choices.description: Rather than die in the death trap, I refuse to become anyone's chess piece. The Tianji Record is my trump card—I absolutely cannot expose it.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the chance to break the death trap
choices.risk_hint: The death in Chapter 700 will arrive as scheduled

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak. He simply stood there quietly, looking up at those suspended eyes, the corners of his lips slowly curving into a cold smile. That smile held no anger, no fear—only a composure that sent chills down one's spine. 'I appreciate the Emissary's kindness.' His voice was light. 'But the thing I despise most in this life is becoming someone else's chess piece. Whether it's the Tianji Pavilion or the Eye of Heavenly Dao—if you want Chen Ji to be obedient and compliant—you're not qualified.'

choices.description: Seven days. Seven days is enough time to feel out more trump cards, perhaps find a third path. Never轻易表露态度.
choices.visible_cost: Need to face the death trap alone
choices.visible_reward: Strive to gain time for investigation and layout
choices.risk_hint: Unexpected changes may occur within seven days

text.content: Chen Ji did not give an immediate answer. His fingers gently rubbed the cuff of his sleeve, where the faint warmth of the Tianji Record Fragment was hidden. His mind was racing rapidly—the confrontation between the Heavenly Secret Pavilion and the Eye of Heavenly Dao meant this chess game was far larger than he had imagined. Rashly taking sides in such a situation would be tantamount to self-destruction. 'What the messenger has said requires Chen Ji to take time to consider.' He raised his head, his gaze calm as water. 'Within seven days, I will certainly give the messenger an answer.'

dialogue.content: 'Interesting.' A flash of appreciation flickered in the messenger's eyes. 'You are far calmer than I anticipated. Since that is the case, I will tell you one more thing—the so-called unavoidable death you mentioned is not as simple as you think.' The messenger's voice suddenly dropped. 'You think Chapter 700 is your end? No, that is merely a 'reset point.' Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply: 'A reset point? What do you mean?' The messenger fell silent for a moment, something flickering across those eyes. 'It means—after death, everything restarts, including all your memories.'

text.content: This sentence struck like thunder in Chen Ji's mind. All memories. Including the cultivation techniques he had painstakingly refined for years, the chess game he had meticulously woven, his concerns for his sister Chen Nian, the bonds he had forged with Su Qingyao, Ye Qing, and others—everything would reset to zero at the moment of death. And he would re-enter this chess game with a brand new identity, stumbling forward in ignorance, then walking toward that destined death once more. Reset. Over and over. Forever trapped in the cage of fate, unable to break free.

dialogue.content: Ye Qing's complexion had turned ashen. She was a Demon Path Saintess who had witnessed countless生死, yet at this moment she was rendered speechless by this cruel truth. She下意识地 looked at Chen Ji, only to find no trace of the fear or collapse she had imagined on his face. Chen Ji merely stood there quietly, his gaze deep and terrifying, as if contemplating something. 'You...' Ye Qing opened her mouth, only to find any words of comfort would be hollow at this moment.

text.content: 'So this is true despair.' Chen Ji suddenly spoke, his voice unexpectedly calm. 'Not dying once and it ending, but dying countless times, each time having to start over. The Eye of Heavenly Dao... what a vicious heart, what a venomous scheme.' He raised his head, directly staring at those floating eyes, sharp light bursting forth. 'The reason the Heavenly Secret Pavilion came to me must be because you do not want to see this reset happen either. Right?' The messenger did not speak, but the flash of light across those eyes was already the best answer.

Chen Ji suddenly laughed. That smile held not a trace of bitterness, but carried a chilling composure. 'Interesting.' he murmured softly. 'It seems this chess game is far larger than I imagined. The Eye of Heavenly Dao wants to tame me, the Heavenly Secret Pavilion wants to use me, and I—' He paused, his gaze suddenly becoming sharp. 'I only want to overturn this entire chess game.' The messenger was silent for a long time, so long that Ye Qing thought the other party would explode in anger. Then, a low laugh rang out in the Void: 'Good. You have courage. I look forward to your answer even more now.'

choice.prompt: The truth of the reset point made everything more urgent. Chen Ji needed to make his final decision within limited time.

choices.description: To break the eternal reset cycle, accept the price of becoming an Observer. Trade foresight for a way out.
choices.visible_cost: The Heavenly Secret Pavilion will share all foresight from the Tianji Record
choices.visible_reward: Obtain the possibility to break the reset
choices.risk_hint: The Heavenly Secret Pavilion's surveillance may bring greater crisis

text.content: 'Very well.' Chen Ji's voice rang out in the Void, as calm as if discussing an ordinary transaction. 'I accept this deal. But I have one condition—I want to know more intelligence about the Eye of Heavenly Dao. If we are to oppose it, I must at least know who the enemy is.' A satisfied light flickered in the messenger's eyes: 'A wise choice. Observer sir, welcome to join the Heavenly Secret Pavilion.'

choices.description: Neither the Heavenly Secret Pavilion nor the Eye of Heavenly Dao can be trusted. Must find a third path. Seven days is enough time to lay groundwork.
choices.visible_cost: Lose the support of the Heavenly Secret Pavilion
choices.risk_hint: Must find a breakthrough within seven days

text.content: 'Unnecessary.' Chen Ji's voice was crisp and decisive. 'Be it the Heavenly Secret Pavilion or the Eye of Heavenly Dao, both merely wish to use me as a chess piece. My life, Chen Ji, is for me to decide. Within seven days, I will find my own path.' His gaze fell on Ye Qing. 'Let's go. We still have much to do.'

choices.memory_label: 陈机在生死抉择面前依然保持独立，这份决绝让夜清更加坚定了追随的决心。

dialogue.content: Ye Qing followed closely behind Chen Ji. The previous scene had shaken her too deeply—she had thought the messenger from the Heavenly Secret Pavilion had only brought an ordinary transaction, never expecting such a shocking truth to be involved. Reset points, eternal cycles, the confrontation between the Eye of Heavenly Dao and the Heavenly Secret Pavilion...这一切都在告诉她，陈机所面临的困境，远比她想象的要深重得多。'陈机……'她忍不住开口，'你真的打算一个人扛下这一切吗？'

text.content: Chen Ji stopped walking and looked back at her. Those eyes no longer held the sharpness he had shown when facing the messenger, replaced instead by a calm that made one's heart ache. 'Ye Qing, are you afraid?' he asked softly. Ye Qing was stunned for a moment, then shook her head: 'I am a Demon Path Saintess, I have seen my share of storms. But this reset point business...' She paused. 'This is the first time I truly feel that fate can make life worse than death.' Upon hearing this, Chen Ji suddenly smiled. That smile held a trace of bitterness, yet also a measure of relief: 'That is precisely why I cannot afford to lose.'

dialogue.content: At that moment, that authoritative voice rang out once more from the depths of the Void—the messenger's voice resounded again: 'Chen Ji, regardless of what choice you make, there is one thing you must remember—the Eye of Heavenly Dao has already noticed you. The death in Chapter 700 will not change, but you still have time. Use these seven days well.' The messenger's voice paused, taking on a meaningful tone. 'Remember, every choice weaves your fate. And your choice—' Those eyes slowly closed. 'Will determine the生死 of countless people.' The words faded, the Void returned to normal, and light once again fell upon the land of the Tianqing Sect. The messenger had vanished.

text.content: Chen Ji stood quietly in place, gazing at that restored Void. His expression revealed no joy or anger, but Ye Qing noticed his fingers trembling slightly—it was not fear, but rage and unwillingness suppressed to the extreme. After a long while, he took a deep breath and slowly exhaled. 'Seven days...' he murmured to himself, a note of determination in his voice. 'Seven days will be enough.' He turned around, his gaze sweeping across Ye Qing's worry-filled face, and suddenly a smile appeared: 'Let's go, back. Since fate wishes to play chess with me, I shall keep it company.' A cold light flickered in his eyes. 'This time, I shall be the chess player, not the piece.'
